title: Feature Flag Rollout Plan
description: A structured plan for one feature flag's type, default, bucketing, ramp, and cleanup metadata, so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/flag_rollout_audit.mjs.

flagType.description: The flag's type, which sets its expected lifetime, owner, and default-value rules.

defaultValue.description: The SDK default returned when the provider is unreachable. Kill switches default true; mid-ramp release flags default false.

namePrefixMatchesType.description: True if the flag key carries its type prefix (release-, kill-, ops-, experiment-, permission-).

hasMaintainer.description: True if a maintainer is assigned in flag metadata at creation time.

ttlDays.description: Target removal window for temporary flags (release/experiment/kill-switch); default 30, max 90.

rolloutStagePercent.description: The current (or initial) percentage of traffic receiving the feature.

usesPercentageRollout.description: True if the flag ramps by percentage (vs. pure targeting/entitlement).

bucketingKey.description: The identity used as targetingKey for sticky bucketing. Session/request IDs cause flicker.

rampStepsPercent.description: The planned ramp schedule, e.g. [1, 5, 25, 50, 100], with at least one traffic cycle between steps.

testsBothPaths.description: True if the suite exercises both the on and off paths (InMemoryProvider or equivalent).

providerFailureBehaviorDocumented.description: True if the default value AND the behavior when the flag service is unreachable are documented (and ideally load-tested).

openFeatureApi.description: True if call sites use the vendor-neutral OpenFeature API rather than a vendor SDK directly.

targetingConditionCount.description: Number of conditions in the flag's targeting rule; more than 3 means the cohort belongs in the evaluation context.

alertWebhookWired.description: Circuit breakers only: true if an alerting webhook can flip the flag automatically.
